newsitem.title: USA: Armco Inc Q4 shr profit $0.08 vs loss $0.12.
newsitem.headline: Armco Inc Q4 shr profit $0.08 vs loss $0.12.

text.p: Three Months Ended Twelve Months Ended

Included in the fourth quarter net income are special charges totaling $8.8 million, or $.08 per share, for a loss on the sale of a construction business and costs associated with exiting a product line and a one-time gain of $4.4 million, or $.04 per share, related to a claims settlement.

The 1996 net income included one-time gains of $6.5 million from a tax settlement related to a divested business, $6.3 million for recognition of previously deferred gains in connection with the sale of certain assets, and $8.6 million for business interruption insurance and other claims settlements and the previously mentioned special charges of $8.8 million. The one-time gains and special charges had a net effect of increasing 1996 earnings by $.12 per share.
